notes.title: Missing football during the COVID-19 Outbreak? We've got your back!
notes.notes:
[list][*] Are you sat at home, in lockdown due to the COVID-19 outbreak?[/list]
[list][*] Already on your 23rd jigsaw, of the 3 you have to choose from?[/list]
[list][*] Bored out of your mind and missing football?[/list]

Look no further....kick-start the 2009/2010 season with Premier Manager 10 and ultimately guide your team to European glory!

With improved playability from previous versions, and ease of use, Premier Manager ‘10 is the ideal game for those who love the high-pressure world of football management without the complications seen in other football management sims, which can take hours to even get to your 1st pre-season friendly.

[h3]We are going to break FIFA/UEFA rules and the Premier Manager '10 season will commence on Friday 17th April 2020![/h3]
